collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A parent hums a soft lullaby inside a nearby hut.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (friend), a parent, hums a soft lullaby inside a nearby hut. (subject) stops on the path to listen for a moment.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (friend), a parent, hums a soft lullaby inside a nearby hut. The lullaby is one (subject)'s own parent used to sing.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (friend), a parent, hums a soft lullaby inside a nearby hut. The humming stops, and the hut falls quiet, the baby asleep at last.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (friend), a parent, hums a soft lullaby inside a nearby hut. A passing child hums along softly, then hurries away, embarrassed.
